name: manki-smoke-jab
notes: PIPELINE SMOKE TEST, not a game move: it checks that the current-character rig pack works end to end.
character: Manki v3 (58 joints; three fingers and a thumb per hand; five-bone tail)
description: A quick right-hand jab from the idle stance. Ticks 1-7 load slightly: the right shoulder draws back and both hands come up into a guard. Ticks 8-10 the right fist extends straight forward at shoulder height; contact at tick 10. Ticks 11-13 hold the extension briefly. Ticks 14-29 retract and settle back to the idle pose; ticks 30-40 equal the idle entry pose exactly. The left hand stays as a guard near the chin. Both feet stay planted; the hips and chest may rotate a little into the punch. Close the right hand into a proper fist for the strike.
image_notes: The idle entry pose on this rig (profile, front, three-quarter rear angle).

targets.name: right fist ahead of chest at contact (m)
right fist below shoulder at contact (m)
